clues: This city rests on the south west shore of the Río de la Plata, a vast river mouth. Wide water spreads from its port toward the open sea.
Hot wet summers rule here, till a cold dry wind sweeps in from the south plains. That wind brings wild storms, then cool clear air.
Spain's king split a vast ruled land and made this port its capital. Trade at last could sail straight across the wide sea.
A bold partner dance was born in the poor port areas along this city's great river in the 1880s. Bands played it in port bars, where its mixed steps first took shape.
This city is the heart of rule for Argentina, as it has been since 1880. Long past, the chief of the land picked its mayor.
